title: Gambler's Quest
author: Chris
description:
It was supposed to be a quiet, ordinary morning at your cottage. You get up, eat breakfast, get dressed for work, and head out to check the mail.

Then an unexpected royal decree changes everything.

Faced with an outrage you simply cannot accept, your quiet routine goes right out the window. Gather whatever supplies you can find in the village and prepare for a questionable, budget-fueled adventure.
